Guidelines

Salon Policies

Please review our guidelines to ensure a relaxing experience for everyone.

Service Guarantee

We take pride in our work. If you experience any issues with your nails (like chipping or lifting) within a reasonable timeframe, please contact us for a complimentary fix.

Cancellation Policy

We require at least 24 hours notice for any cancellations or rescheduling. Late cancellations may be subject to a fee.

Late Arrival

If you are more than 15 minutes late, we may need to reschedule your appointment or shorten your service time to accommodate other clients.

Walk-Ins

Walk-ins are always welcome, but appointments are highly recommended to guarantee your preferred time and technician.

Payment & Gratuity

We accept Cash, Visa, Mastercard, and Discover. Gratuities are greatly appreciated and can be left in cash or added to your card.

Kids & Guests

For the safety of children and the relaxation of our guests, we ask that children only accompany you if they are receiving a service.

Accessibility

Our salon is fully wheelchair accessible. Please let us know if you require any special accommodations when booking.
